title: Total golden churn: every tick hash in all three demos changed while seed, logic_hz, and tick counts are untouched
detail: Zero of 780 tick hashes survive the change; seeds, logic_hz, and tick counts are identical. The change altered global determinism, not a localized path, and wholesale regeneration gives no per-tick evidence that any expected behavior was preserved.
recommended_fix: Add a regeneration note explaining why every demo changed, and verify the goldens were produced by running the suite against the new code rather than hand-edited.

title: Three binary golden logs changed with no reviewable content
evidence:
Binary files a/goldens/qos_contention.log.bin and b/goldens/qos_contention.log.bin differ
Binary files a/goldens/qos_emphasis.log.bin and b/goldens/qos_emphasis.log.bin differ
Binary files a/goldens/sla.log.bin and b/goldens/sla.log.bin differ
detail: If the .t1 tick hashes are derived from these binaries, no reviewer can confirm the new hashes reflect legitimate frame content rather than truncation, corruption, or accidental overwrite.
recommended_fix: Pair binary regeneration with a text transcript or a note stating the regeneration command and confirming the binaries were produced by the updated code.

title: catalog_hash bumped; any .t1 golden outside this chunk still embedding the old hash will fail its catalog check
detail: The catalog hash is embedded in every .t1 manifest; this chunk proves only three files were updated. Any other golden .t1 in the repository still carrying bd13d5dfba445d80 now mismatches the catalog.
recommended_fix: Confirm every .t1 golden in the repository was regenerated with 8da858ab04b113db, including any demos outside this chunk.

title: Consecutive tick hashes 146/147 share a 16-bit prefix — the only such adjacent pair in the entire chunk
detail: One adjacent-pair prefix collision among 777 adjacent pairs (expected ~0.01 for well-mixing 64-bit hashes) suggests an unusually small state delta or weak hash mixing at that transition.
recommended_fix: Verify the tick 146-147 state delta in the binary log and confirm the tick hash function avalanches small input differences.
